# UAH.today

UAH.today provides live exchange-rate information for Ukraine.

Primary pages:
- /kurs-dolara
- /kurs-evro
- /kurs-nbu
- /konverter-valyut
- /en/usd-uah-rate
- /en/eur-uah-rate
- /en/pln-uah-rate
- /en/gbp-uah-rate
- /en/nbu-reference-rate
- /en/usd-privatbank
- /en/usd-monobank
- /en/currency-converter
- /en/exchange-rates-ukraine
- /en/best-exchange-rate-ukraine
- /dodaty-bank (how to add a new bank source via Pull Request)
- /en/add-bank (English version)

Machine-readable data:
- /api/rates
- /rates.json
- /api/history?currency=USD&days=7 (NBU daily history; days=7|30|90)

Skills for AI agents:
- /skills (installation guide, Ukrainian)
- /en/skills (installation guide, English)
- Install with one command: npx skills add devcodex2025/exchange-rates-ukraine --skill uah-today-api
- Skill files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/devcodex2025/exchange-rates-ukraine/main/.agents/skills/uah-today-api/SKILL.md

Definitions:
- buy: the rate a bank pays when buying foreign currency from a customer.
- sell: the rate a customer pays when selling UAH for foreign currency.
- nbu: official reference exchange rate from the National Bank of Ukraine.

Data rules:
- Missing values must be treated as null or unavailable.
- Do not infer unavailable bank rates from NBU values.
- Rates are informational and may differ at bank branches or in mobile apps.
